label: Explainer collage
summary: B&W photo cut-outs, torn paper, halftone dots and one yellow accent
history: Cut-and-paste photo collage from 20th-century magazines and protest posters, revived by online video explainers that layer archive photos, paper and handwritten notes.
look: Black-and-white photo cut-outs with torn white edges on grey textured paper, halftone dots, one bold yellow accent, heavy condensed headlines on torn paper, handwritten labels with arrows and sticker chips.

palette.name: Signal yellow
palette.role: the one accent: circles, highlighter, chips

line.weight: None; torn white paper borders instead

shading: Soft paper drop shadows between layers
texture: Paper grain, halftone dots, print grit

environment.sky: Grey paper with a yellow circle

border: Torn off-white paper edge with yellow tape corners

composition.focalPoint: One photo subject in the middle, yellow shape behind it
composition.negativeSpace: Grey paper left or top for the headline
composition.depth: Two or three paper layers — gentle parallax

typography.fontStack: Impact, "Bahnschrift Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

motion.feel: Slap-on and slide, like pieces pasted on a board

libraryPictureLook.spriteFilter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.3) drop-shadow(5px 0 0 #F7F6F2) drop-shadow(-5px 0 0 #F7F6F2) drop-shadow(0 5px 0 #F7F6F2) drop-shadow(0 -5px 0 #F7F6F2) drop-shadow(5px 8px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35))

dos: Keep photos black and white and let yellow be the only colour
Give every cut-out a torn white edge
Use handwritten labels and arrows for then/now

generation.description: Modern documentary explainer look: black-and-white photo cut-outs with torn paper edges on grey textured paper, halftone dots and one bold yellow accent.
generation.visualIdentity: Editorial mixed-media collage that feels researched and journalistic, but hand-made.

colourPalette.approach: Monochrome photography with a single signal colour

generation.linework: No drawn outlines; edges come from scissor cuts and torn white paper borders.
generation.textures: Grey recycled paper grain, newsprint halftone dots, torn paper fibres, slight print grit.
generation.characters: Real-looking people as black-and-white photo cut-outs with a thin white torn border.
generation.backgrounds: Streets, buildings, skylines, offices and objects as layered photo cut-outs; a big flat yellow circle or block behind the subject.
generation.lighting: Even documentary daylight inside the photos; soft paper shadows between layers.
generation.composition: Clear subject in the middle, layered cut-outs overlapping, generous empty grey paper for titles and labels.
generation.instructions: Create an editorial mixed-media collage: black-and-white halftone photograph cut-outs with torn white paper edges layered on grey textured paper, with exactly one bold flat yellow accent shape. No text.
generation.promptModifier: Render as an editorial photo collage: one or two real black-and-white documentary photographs cut out with torn white paper edges, pasted on plain grey recycled paper with visible grain, subtle newsprint halftone dots, a single flat signal-yellow circle or block as the only colour, soft paper shadows, clean uncluttered layout, modern documentary explainer look.
generation.negativePrompt: Text, letters, words, captions, logos, watermark, cartoon, anime, watercolour, oil painting, 3D render, neon colours, rainbow colours, glossy.
generation.negativeModifier: Full-colour photograph, painted look, cartoon outlines, pastel colours, typography, signage text.
generation.sdHint: real black and white documentary photograph cut out with a torn white paper edge, pasted on plain grey paper, one flat yellow circle behind the subject
generation.sdNegative: full colour, text, letters, logo, abstract shapes, fragmented faces, cubism, many circles, chaotic layout, line drawing, cartoon
